sloka: अथाहमुत्तरं देव्या पुनरुक्तः ससम्भ्रमः ।तव स्नेहान्नरव्याघ्र सौहार्दादनुमान्य वै ।। ५.६८.१ ।।।।
transliteration: athāhamuttaraṁ devyā punaruktaḥ sasambhramaḥ ।tava snehānnaravyāghra sauhārdādanumānya vai ।। 5.68.1 ।।।।

translations.english: "O tiger among men In view of her regards for me and and her love for you she was confident and once again addressed me:
